items.description: Create a finding when a component relationship required UOM is null, empty, or whitespace.
items.threshold_or_configuration: UOM_CODE must be populated after trimming whitespace.

items.description: Create a finding when component quantity is null, zero, or negative.
items.threshold_or_configuration: QUANTITY must be greater than zero.

items.description: Create a finding when duplicate parent/component/operation/effectivity relationship rows exist.
items.threshold_or_configuration: Normalized parent, component, operation sequence including null, and effectivity dates including null must be unique.

items.description: Create a finding when a component lifecycle status is obsolete while the parent BOM remains current.
items.threshold_or_configuration: Configured obsolete statuses: OBSOLETE, INACTIVE, END_OF_LIFE.

items.description: Create a finding when effectivity end is earlier than effectivity start.
items.threshold_or_configuration: EFFECTIVITY_END must be greater than or equal to EFFECTIVITY_START when both are provided.

items.description: Create a finding when traversal of the staged BOM graph returns to an item already present in the path.
items.threshold_or_configuration: Component graph must be acyclic within each latest BOM structure.

items.description: Create a finding when a positive quantity violates the configured lower or upper threshold.
items.threshold_or_configuration: ANOMALY_MIN_QUANTITY and ANOMALY_MAX_QUANTITY define prototype bounds.
